title: Golbat's Hunger Can Cost It Its Fangs
premise: Hunger can drive Golbat to bite a Steel-type Pokémon and lose some of its hollow fangs.
audiencePromise: Show how hunger drives Golbat to bite a Steel-type and lose some fangs.
openLoop: What kind of bite can make Golbat lose its own fangs?
payoff: Golbat's hollow fangs suck blood, but biting Steel can make it lose some.
engagementQuestion: Cool weakness or terrible design choice?

voice.instructions: Use a tense, curious pace. Pause briefly before each reveal, then land the final question clearly.

scenes.headline: THE WRONG BITE
scenes.narration: Golbat bit the wrong Pokémon and lost some teeth.
scenes.caption: SOME GOLBAT ARE MISSING FANGS

scenes.headline: TEETH LIKE STRAWS
scenes.narration: Its fangs are hollow like straws, making them unexpectedly fragile.
scenes.caption: HOLLOW FANGS = FRAGILE FANGS

scenes.headline: THE TARGET IS STEEL
scenes.narration: But hunger can drive Golbat to bite a Steel-type Pokémon.
scenes.caption: HUNGER PICKS THE WORST TARGET

scenes.headline: THE BITE BACKFIRES
scenes.narration: That bite can leave Golbat missing some of its fangs.
scenes.caption: STEEL CAN TAKE ITS FANGS

scenes.headline: ITS WEAPON IS ALSO WEAK
scenes.narration: Those hollow fangs are made for blood, but unexpectedly fragile.
scenes.caption: BUILT TO DRAIN. EASY TO BREAK.

scenes.headline: WEAKNESS OR BAD DESIGN?
scenes.narration: Cool weakness or terrible design choice?
scenes.caption: WHICH SIDE ARE YOU ON?
